Who we are

Jack & Kai.
Built for local business.

We met at school in Sussex — two lads obsessed with business and fascinated by what AI was going to do to the world. Since then we’ve travelled 10 countries together, chased ideas across three continents, and never stopped building.

Jack represents England and Great Britain in hockey. Kai is a gym fanatic who never misses a session. Between us we cover design, development, strategy, and everything in between.

We started WebbShaw because we saw brilliant local businesses being left behind online. Our mission is simple — give every small business access to AI-powered websites, without them having to lift a finger.
